proved_exactly: The four published transvections generate a 40-point permutation group of order 25920.
Every three-transvection face has order 648 and fixes one W33 point.
There are 432 A5 subgroups in two orbits of 216, with 1296 D10-sharing edges and 36 K6,6 components.
Every D10-sharing edge generates A6, and the A6 normalizer has order 720.
The rank-24 carrier spans all 300 symmetric and all 276 alternating bilinear directions.
The projector Gram Smith profile is 2^1, 10^9, 30^6, 60^8, with discriminant 2^32 3^14 5^23.
No rational scalar rescaling of the same rank-24 form can admit a unimodular overlattice.
The rootless rank-24 theta numerator times the 24-boson product reproduces the first listed J+24 coefficients.
